name: item
summary: A row in a list: a title, a description, leading media and trailing actions; pressable when it opens something.

properties.name: title
properties.description: What the row is, such as a recipe's name.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A short line under the title.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: plain has no frame, for rows in a group; outline is a bordered box for a row on its own.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Space above and below the words: md 12, sm 8.

properties.name: mediaSize
properties.description: icon is a 40-point muted tile with a symbol, hidden from assistive technology; sm, md and lg are 40, 64 and 112-point pictures.

slots.name: media
slots.description: An icon or a picture before the words.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls after the words, such as a badge or a button. They go under the words at the largest text sizes.

events.name: press
events.description: The row was pressed. A row with a press handler is one button named by its title, at least 44 points tall.

states.name: hover
states.description: A pressable row under a pointer: a muted fill.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A pressable row held down: the muted fill a step stronger.

states.name: focused
states.description: A pressable row with keyboard focus: the platform's focus ring.

accessibility.name: Its title; a pressable row is described by its description too.
accessibility.keyboard: A pressable row is one tab stop; Enter and Space press it. Its actions are their own tab stops.
accessibility.web: A <div> (or li, article); with href the title's link stretches over the row.
accessibility.apple: With onPress, one button named by its title and description; its actions stay their own controls.
accessibility.windows: Pressable: UI Automation ControlType.Button with the Invoke pattern, named by its title, help text its description. Otherwise ControlType.Group named by its title. Actions keep their own controls.

cases.person: A row with a flame tile, the title and description, and a New badge at the end.
A plain row with the title and description.

deviations: With href the whole row is one link; native rows take a press handler instead.
